title: Aalam Nehaan Hai Zaatay Risalat Ma’aab
body:
Aalam Nehaan Hai Zaatay Risalat Ma’aab Mein
Kitnay Hain Aftaab Iss Aik Aftaab Mein
<<DIVIDER>>
Kholoon Zaban Kaisay Ali Ki Janaab Mein
Aik Sheheray Ilm Hai Jo Dar Aaya Hai Baab Mein
<<DIVIDER>>
Saf Basta Kainaat Hai Meri Janaab Mein
Mehway Sana Hoon Bargahay Bu Turab Mein
<<DIVIDER>>
Munkir Nakeer Kar Na Sakay Phir Koyi Sawal
Naaday Ali Jo Meine Sunaayi Jawab Mein
<<DIVIDER>>
Lelay Na Jaan Hasratay Deedar Ya Imam
Bas Ab Na Aazmaayi Ye Rehkar Hijab Mein
<<DIVIDER>>
Naamay Khuda Ali Hai Toh Ismay Imam Bhi
Dono Mazay Hain Bandagi E Bu Turab Mein
<<DIVIDER>>
Rakhta Hai Kadd Jo Dil Mein Ali Se Usse Kabhi
Jannat Naseeb Ho Nahi Sakti Hai Khwaab Mein
<<DIVIDER>>
Karti Jo Baabay Ilm Se Ummat Husoolay Ilm
Yoon Thokarein Na Khaati Rahay Intekhaab Mein
<<DIVIDER>>
Dushman Wasiye Ahmad E Mursal Ka Ba Khuda
Yaan Tha Azaabay Jaan Wahan Hai Azaab Mein
<<DIVIDER>>
Khaaya Kisi Se Aur Na Lagaya Kisi Ko Zakhm
Aisay Bhi Thay Janab Nabi Ki Janab Mein
<<DIVIDER>>
Qeemat Lagi Jo Ashkay Aza E Husain Ki
Jannat Tamam Hogayi Mere Hisaab Mein
<<DIVIDER>>
Akbar Ne Barchi Khaayi Hai Ayn E Shabab Mein
Aisa Gehen Laga Na Kabhi Aftaab Mein
<<DIVIDER>>
Parday Toh Daaltay Rahay Har Daur Ke Yazeed
Lekin Chupa Na Zulm Ka Chehra Naqab Mein
<<DIVIDER>>
Sad Marhaba Tumhari Zaeefi Ko Aye Habeeb
Kya Koyi Yoon Jihad Karega Shabab Mein
<<DIVIDER>>
Jiska Hadaf Tha Asghar E Masoom Ka Gala
Jaa Kar Laga Hai Teer Woh Qalbay Rubab Mein
<<DIVIDER>>
Sughra Watan Mein Kehti Theen Baba Ki Khayr Ho
Daadi Ko Sar Khulay Huway Dekha Hai Khwaab Mein
<<DIVIDER>>
Baali Sakina Kehti Thi Paani Mein Kya Piyoon
Surat Nazar Jo Aati Hai Asghar Ki Aab Mein
<<DIVIDER>>
Taa Hashr Aye Saleem Jo Hasti Karay Wafa
Likhta Rahoon Mein Saqi E Kausar Ke Baab Mein
